title: Writing a Persuasive Essay
text:
A persuasive essay tries to convince the reader to agree with the writer's opinion. To do this, the writer must give clear reasons and strong evidence. Many students write persuasive essays at school, for example about whether homework should be banned. A good essay also considers the other side of the argument.

One common mistake is to use only emotional words without facts. Readers are more likely to trust a writer who uses examples, statistics, and expert opinions. Finally, a strong essay ends with a conclusion that repeats the main idea in a memorable way.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is the main purpose of a persuasive essay?
options: To tell a story about the writer's life
To convince the reader to agree with an opinion
To list the facts of a historical event
To describe a place in detail

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what is a common mistake?
options: Ending the essay with a question
Using only emotional words without facts

questions.text: What can be inferred about readers who trust a writer?
options: They prefer essays with no facts at all
They are more convinced by evidence than by feelings alone
They always disagree with the writer

questions.text: Why does the writer mention the other side of the argument?
options: To show that the writer has thought about different views

vocabulary.definition: to make someone agree with an idea
facts or information that show something is true
a set of reasons used to support or oppose an idea
the final part of an essay that sums up the main idea

paragraph_translations: İkna edici bir yazı, okuyucuyu yazarın görüşüne katılmaya ikna etmeye çalışır. Bunu yapmak için yazar açık nedenler ve güçlü kanıtlar sunmalıdır. Birçok öğrenci okulda, örneğin ödevlerin yasaklanması gerekip gerekmediği hakkında bu tür yazılar yazar. İyi bir yazı ayrıca argümanın diğer tarafını da dikkate alır.

Sık yapılan bir hata, gerçekleri olmadan yalnızca duygusal kelimeler kullanmaktır. Okuyucular, örnekler, istatistikler ve uzman görüşleri kullanan bir yazara daha çok güvenir. Son olarak, güçlü bir yazı, ana fikri akılda kalıcı bir şekilde tekrarlayan bir sonuçla biter.
